description: Source file implementing configuration translation functions for CU-UP units, including generating CU-UP configs, QoS configs, and worker manager configs, with references to related headers and helper functions.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_config
methods.description: Generates a CU-UP configuration object from a given unit configuration, setting various parameters including report periods, timers, and test modes.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_qos_config
methods.description: Creates a map of QoS configurations indexed by five_qi, either default or based on provided QoS configs, converting specific QoS parameters.

methods.name: fill_cu_up_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates a worker_manager_config object with CU-UP related settings derived from a unit configuration, including executor queue sizes and pcap settings.
